original: baddho nigalitaḥ, asiddho vā | coraklībau prasiddhau | raṅgāvatārī mallādiḥ | vaiṇo vīṇāvādī | abhiśastaḥ patanīyakarmakartvenābhiyuktaḥ | vārdhuṣyaṃ niṣiddhavṛddhyupajīvanaṃ tena tadvān lakṣyate | gaṇikā veśyā | gaṇaḥ saṅghaḥ | dīkṣī [239] dīkṣaṇīyeṣṭyādijanitadīkṣākhyasaṃskāravān | dikṣākhyasaṃskāravt tvaṃ cāvabhṛtheṣṭeḥ prāg eva avabhṛtheṣṭyā tatsaṃskārāpagamāt evaṃ ca dīkṣaṇīyeṣṭyanuṣṭhānaprabhṛti avabhṛtheṣṭyanuṣṭhānaparyantaṃ dīkṣitasyābhojyānnatvam anayā smṛtyā pratipāditam iti yady api pratibhāti | tathāpi "saṃsthite 'gnīṣomīye yajamānasya gṛhe 'śitavyam" ityādiśrutyā saty api dīkṣākhyasaṃskāre agnīṣoīyapaśuyāgasamāpteḥ prāg eva abhojyānntavam anayā smṛtyāpy uktam iti mantavyam | cikitsako bhiṣak | āturaḥ pāparogagrastaḥ | pāparogāś ca devalena darśitāḥ |

original: vātavyādhiḥ pakṣamārakādiḥ | aśmarī mūtrakṛcchram | meho madhumehādiḥ | udaraṃ jalodarādiḥ | itare prasiddhāḥ | kruddho dhṛtābhyantarakopaḥ | puṃścalī asatī | matto dhanādigarvitaḥ | paradhikkāraśīlaḥ | vidviṭ śatruḥ | krūro nirdayaḥ | ugraḥ paraduḥkhotpādanaparaḥ | patito mahāpātakī | vrātyaḥ patitasāvitrīkaḥ | ḍāmbhikaḥ khyātilābhādiprayojanānusaṃdhānenaiva dharmānuṣṭhātā | uccchiṣṭabhojī parabhuktojjhitānnabhojanaśīlaḥ | avīrastrī niṣpatisutā, "avīrā niṣpatisutā" ity amarasiṃhenābhidhānāt | svarṇakāraḥ kaṭakamakuṭādisvarṇavikārakārī | strījitaḥ sarvakāryeṣu strīvaśavartī | grāmayājī anekagrāmayājakaḥ śastravikrayī [240] khaḍgādivikrayajīvī | śvavṛttiḥ śvavṛttavān sevaka iti yāvat | nṛśaṃso ghātukaḥ | rājā janapadapurapālakaḥ rajako vastrādirāgakartā | yaḥ prāṇivadhena (?) jīvati sa vadhajīvī | celadhāvaḥ vastraprakṣālakaḥ | surājīvaḥ surāvikrayī | sahopapativeśmā bhāryā jārasahitagṛhaḥ | eṣāṃ kadaryatvādidoṣaduṣṭānāṃ traivarṇikānām annaṃ somalatāvikrayādidoṣaduṣṭasya traivarṇikasyānnaṃ kadaryatvādidoṣaduṣṭasvāmisaṃbandhāt paramparayā duṣṭam annaṃ na bhoktavyam ity arthaḥ | yady api dīkṣitānnasyāśrayakṛtaduṣṭatvābhāvaḥ, tathāpi vacanabalād evābhojyatvam | anyad api traivarṇakānnaṃ svāśrayagarhitam abhojyaṃ vacobhaṅgyā paiṭhīnasir āha: "sāṃvatsarikaghaṇṭikagrāmakūṭānnaṃ viṣaṃ parivittiparivividānaviddhaprajananavṛṣalīpatididhiṣūpatipunarbhūputrāṇāṃ rudhiram" iti | sāṃvatsariko jyautiṣikaḥ | ghāṇṭiko nighaṇṭukāreṇa nirūpitaḥ: "rājñāṃ prabodhasamaye ghaṇṭāśilpas tu ghāṇṭikaḥ" iti | grāmakūṭo grāme 'nanyādhīnatakṣakaḥ "kūṭatakṣo 'nadhīnakaḥ" ity amaraḥ | viṣaṃ viṣavad abhakṣyam | yasmin akṛtadāre jyeṣṭhe kaniṣṭhena dāraparigrahaḥ kriyate sa jyeṭḥaḥ parivittiḥ | ya ādhānāni jyeṣṭhenākṛtāni karoty asau kaniṣṭhaḥ parivividānaḥ | viddhaprajanano viddhaśiśnaḥ | didhiṣūpatiḥ punarbhūpatiḥ | rudhiraṃ rudhiravad abhakṣyam | yamo 'pi |
analyzed: vāta vyādhiḥ pakṣa māraka ādiḥ aśmarī mūtrakṛcchram mehaḥ madhumeha ādiḥ udaram jalodara ādiḥ itare prasiddhāḥ kruddhaḥ dhṛta abhyantara kopaḥ puṃścalī asatī mattaḥ dhana ādi garvitaḥ para dhikkāra śīlaḥ vidviṣ śatruḥ krūraḥ nirdayaḥ ugraḥ para duḥkha utpādana paraḥ patitaḥ mahāpātakī vrātyaḥ patitasāvitrīkaḥ ḍāmbhikaḥ khyāti lābha ādi prayojana anusaṃdhānena eva dharma anuṣṭhātā ucchiṣṭa bhojī para bhukta ujjh

original: vaiśvadevasamanvitaṃ mātāmahaśrāddhaṃ bhaktisaṃpannaḥ āvṛtaṃ kurvītety arthaḥ | atra prāptāprāptavivekena vaisvadevam āvṛtaṃ kurvītety uktaṃ bhavati | vaiśvdevetarāṅgopetapradhānāvṛtter nyāyat eva siddhatvāt, vaisvadeve tu tantrāvṛttī pūrvam asiddhe idānīm eva [276] pratipādanīye | etac ca vākyam evaṃ vyākhyeyam, anyathā tantraṃ vā vaiśvadaivikam iti pakṣāntarābhidhānāghaṭanāt | tathā hi pūrvavākye āvṛttipakṣe anukte pakṣāntaratayā tantrābhidhānam anupapannam eva | tantraṃ vā vaiśvadaivikam ity asyāyam arthaḥ: vaiśvadaivikakarmānuṣṭhānaṃ pitṛmātamahaśrāddhadvayārthaṃ tantreṇa vā kartavyaṃ sakṛd vā kartavyam iti | ayaṃ tu tantrānuṣṭhānapakṣaḥ sāṅgayoḥ pitṛmātāmahaśrāddhayoḥ ekaprayogavidhiyojyatve bhavitum arhati, na bhinnaprayogavidhiprayojyatve, "bhinnaprayogavidhiprayojyeṣu padārtheṣ na tantratā" iti tantracintādhyāye pratipaditatvāt | tataś ca tantrapakṣoktyaiva pitṛmātāmahaśrāddhayor ekaprayogavidhiprayojyatvam apy uktam | ekaprayogavidhiprayojyatvaṃ caikādhikārāpūrvasādhakatve bhavati, ekādhikārāpūrvasādhakatvam apy asmād eva vākyād anayor jñāyate | etena caikādhikārāpūrvasādhakatvam anayoḥ pākṣikam iti vāśabdāt jñāyate | tena bhinnādhikārāpūrvasādhakatvam apy astīti vāśabdād evāvagantavyam | tataś ca prathamaṃ paitṛkaśrāddhaṃ saṃkalpaprabhṛti brāhmaṇavisarjanāntaṃ kāryam ity asmād eva vākyāt jñāyate | na ca vācyaṃ bhaktisaṃpanna it vacanāt bhaktyabhāve mātāmahaśrāddhaṃ na kartavyam iti,
analyzed: vaiśvadeva samanvitam mātāmahaśrāddham bhakti saṃpannaḥ āvṛtam kurvīta iti arthaḥ atra prāpta aprāpta vivekena vaisvadevam āvṛtam kurvīta iti uktam bhavati vaiśvdeva itara aṅga upeta pradhāna āvṛtteḥ nyāyat eva siddha tvāt vaisvadeve tu tantra āvṛttī pūrvam asiddhe idānīm eva pratipādanīye etat ca vākyam evam vyākhyeyam anyathā tantram vā vaiśvadaivikam iti pakṣa antara abhidhāna āghaṭanāt tathā hi pūrva vākye āvṛtti pakṣe anukte pakṣa antara ta

analyzed: na ca evam purūrava ārdrava saṃjñika rūpaḥ dharmaḥ pārvaṇa vat viśveṣām devānām atra syāt iti vācyam viṣṇudharmottare nāndīmukha saṃjñā rūpa vaiśeṣika dharma abhidhānasya smṛti antara ukta vaiśeṣika dharma pradarśana artha tvāt tasmāt satyaḥ nāndīmukhaḥ vasuḥ iti adayaḥ smṛti antra uktāḥ viśeṣāḥ vṛddhiśrāddhe grāhyāḥ tatra tāvat śātātapena kecana uktāḥ

original: prāṅmukhaḥ kartā devatīrthena paitṛkam ap karmajātaṃ kuryād iti tṛtīyapādasyārthaḥ | kṣipraṃ deśādimārjanaṃ bhuktavatsu dvijeṣu tāni bhojanasthānāni saṃmārjanaṃ kartuṃ kartuḥ prāṅmukhatvaṃ bhoktṛṣūdaṅmukheṣu satsu kathaṃcid viprābhimukhyasaṃbhavād yujyate | na tu prāṅmukheṣu bhoktṛṣu | tenodaṅmukhān brāhmaṇān bhojayed iti pakṣo 'smād vacanād gamyata ity avagantavyam | viṣṇupurāṇokte tu prāṅmukhān brāhmaṇān bhojayed iti pakṣe kathaṃcid viprābhimukhyaṃ kartur udaṅmukhatve sati yujyate na tu prāṅmukhatva iti kartur udaṅmukhatvapakṣas tadvacanād gamyata iti boddhavyam | evaṃ ca yadā prāṅmukhā viprās tadā kartodaṅmukha āvahanādikaṃ kuryāt | yadā tu viprā udaṅmukhāḥ tadā kartā prāṅmukha ity avagantavyam | ata eva āśvalāyanagṛhyapariśiṣṭam: "ābhyudayike yugmāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ | amūlā darbhāḥ | prāṅmukhebhya udaṅmukho dadyāt | udamukhebhyaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ | dvau darbhau pavitre" iti | bhaviṣyatpurāṇe 'pi viśeṣa uktaḥ |
analyzed: prāc mukhaḥ kartā deva tīrthena paitṛkam karma jātam kuryāt iti tṛtīya pādasya arthaḥ kṣipram deśa ādi mārjanam bhuktavatsu dvijeṣu tāni bhojana sthānāni saṃmārjanam kartum kartuḥ prāc mukha tvam bhoktṛṣu udak mukheṣu satsu kathaṃcid vipra ābhimukhya saṃbhavāt yujyate na tu prāc mukheṣu bhoktṛṣu tena udak mukhān brāhmaṇān bhojayet iti pakṣaḥ u smāt vacanāt gamyate iti avagantavyam viṣṇupurāṇa ukte tu prāc mukhān brāhmaṇān bhojayet iti

original: pārvaṇe jalodbhavāni rakapuṣpāṇi vihitāni taditararaktapuṣpāṇi pratiṣiddhāni ih jalodbhavaraktapuṣpasyāpi praṣedhārthaṃ raktapuṣpagrahaṇam | kena tarhi tilakāryaṃ kartavyam ity apekṣite kātyāyanaḥ: "yavais tilārthaḥ" iti |
analyzed: pārvaṇe jala udbhavāni raka puṣpāṇi vihitāni tad itara rakta puṣpāṇi pratiṣiddhāni iha jala udbhava rakta puṣpasya api praṣedha artham rakta puṣpa grahaṇam kena tarhi tila kāryam kartavyam iti apekṣite kātyāyanaḥ yavaiḥ tila arthaḥ iti

original: tilārthas tilakāryaṃ yavaiḥ kartavyam ity arthaḥ | evaṃ ca "tilo 'si somadevatyaḥ" iti mantre yavosīty ūhaḥ kārya ity aha sa eva "tatra yavo 'sīty ūhaḥ" iti | tatra tathāsati tilakāryārthaṃ yavopādāne satīy arthaḥ | annatyāgādau svadhāśabdo na prayoktavya ity āha sa eva: "na svadhāṃ prayuñjīta" iti | evaṃ ca "svadhā namaḥ" ity atra "svāhārghyāḥ" ity evaṃ prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ,
analyzed: tila arthaḥ tila kāryam yavaiḥ kartavyam iti arthaḥ evam ca tilaḥ si soma devatyaḥ iti mantre yavaḥ asi iti ūhaḥ kāryaḥ iti aha saḥ eva tatra yavaḥ u si iti ūhaḥ iti tatra tathā asati tila kārya artham yava upādāne sati arthaḥ anna tyāga ādau svadhā śabdaḥ na prayoktavyaḥ iti āha saḥ eva na svadhām prayuñjīta iti evam ca svadhā namaḥ iti atra svāhā arghyāḥ iti evam prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ
